Method of Attack: Account takeover via SCIM feature exploiting group SAML SSO configuration allowing arbitrary user invitation and email change to attacker-controlled address without 2FA
Cross-site scripting (XSS) in Jira integration component
HTML injection in contact list details enabling XSS attacks
Impacted Systems: GitLab Community and Enterprise Edition versions 11.10 through 14.9.4, 14.10 through 14.10.3, and 15.0
Attack Vector: Exploitation of SCIM feature with group SAML SSO configured and absence of 2FA
Input validation failure in contact list details
Indicators of Compromise: Presence of vulnerable GitLab versions 11.10 to 14.9.4, 14.10 to 14.10.3, and 15.0
Use of group SAML SSO with SCIM feature enabled
